{{Quote|We've got one avenue left, but it's too dangerous for Kamus or me--an old compound Czerka used as a staging area. [...] After Czerka left, the compound was taken over by a gang of Gamorrean raiders who, I discovered, don't appreciate visitors.|[[Fauler]]|<ref name="TOR:TA" />}}
An abandoned '''Czerka facility''' was located in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. This underground complex was built by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] beneath a [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]] and was therefore undetectable from the surface. The facility was used by Czerka as a staging area to support a [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|secret weapon project]] on Tatooine. The project was eventually cancelled and the complex was abandoned, allowing [[Shurg's Gamorrean clan]] to take it over.<ref name="TOR:TA" />

Decades later, when [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] decided to come back and secure the data they left at the facility, Czerka official [[Gayem Leksende]] made a deal with [[Shurg]]'s [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] to supply them with weapons and speeders in exchange for access to the compound. Czerka personnel brought [[Czerka Mark 4 Droid|Mark 4]] [[Czerka tripod battledroid|battledroids]] with them, and stationed at the facility along with Gamorreans for some time, until an associate of [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] agent [[Fauler]], who was looking for the same old data, found the facility and killed [[Shurg]], [[Unnamed Czerka security commander|a Czerka security commander]], and many of Czerka and Gammorean forces alike, seeing the latter as a clear danger to the local civilians.<ref>{{TORcite|type=bonus|There Goes the Farm|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> Afterwards, securing the data for SIS, they left the compound, leaving it abandoned once again.<ref name="TOR:TA" />
